description: Base schema for a Solargis data request - not used directly in public APIs. See special public request types derived from the base.

fromDate.description: Start date of the requested data. Inclusive. See also the utcOffset.

toDate.description: End date of the requested data. Inclusive. See also the utcOffset.

utcOffset.description: ISO 8601 time zone designator (offset from UTC) formatted as [±]hh:mm. Allows only whole hour or half-hour offsets in the range ±14:30. If this property is missing, the offset is derived from the site longitude as the nearest whole hour (longitude / 15), e.g. longitude 17.3 gives +01:00 and -100.0 gives -07:00. This is not the civil time zone of the site and it does not follow daylight saving time.

timeAlignment.description: Datetime strings (labels of time intervals) can be positioned or aligned with the start, center or end of the time interval (or the left edge, the middle and the right edge of the time interval).

terrainShading.description: This attribute affects all related parameters (e.g., GHI, DIF, DNI, GTI, PVOUT, TMOD except parameters with explicit _NOSHD suffix.)

gtiConfiguration.description: Object is required if at least one GTI related column is present in the array of columns.

pvConfiguration.description: Object is required if at least one PV output related column is present in the array of columns (PVOUT, TMOD).
pvConfiguration.$comment: One schema for every PV simulation engine; the engine is selected by the simulationEngine property.

stochasticGenerator.description: For 1, 5 and 10 minute time steps, the solar irradiation values can be synthetically generated from 15 minute data.

includeSurfaceAlbedoLongTerm.description: Include long-term average of surface albedo in the output dataset. The value is taken from the user request (if value is present) or from the Solargis database (if not provided by user). Only for SOLARGIS_JSON and SOLARGIS_PARQUET format.

includeHorizon.description: Include horizon object in the output dataset (used for shading). The value is taken from the user request (if value is present) or from the Solargis database (if not provided by user). Only for SOLARGIS_JSON and SOLARGIS_PARQUET format.

includeJsonData.description: Include data section in the dataset. If false, the data is provided elsewhere e.g., as file or URI, and dataset just holds the metadata. Only for SOLARGIS_JSON and SOLARGIS_PARQUET format.

includeModelUncertaintyYearly.description: Include details about the yearly model uncertainty in the processing section of the metadata.
includeModelUncertaintyYearly.$comment: For TMY datasets for other scenario than P50 (e.g., P90, P75, PXX...) the false value is ignored internally and the uncertainty details are always included in datasets.

outputRoundingLevel.description: Defines the decimal precision used for numeric output values in datasets.

includeForecastModelColumns.description: Next to the blended forecast, return each forecast model's values as separate columns: GHI, DNI, DIF, DHI and GTI with its components (with and without terrain shading), and LEADTIME, for those requested in columns. Named <column>_<model> (historical forecast CONCATENATED: <column>_<model>_<leadPeriod>; SINGLE and the live forecast have no lead period), e.g. GHI_IFS, GHI_ICONEU_D1, LEADTIME_NOWCAST_H1, with the model in the column metadata (forecastModel). Values are taken before blending, with the same terrain shading as the blended columns. The models are those the forecast blending scheme uses for this site (a regional scheme contributes only the models of the region the site is in); a model column is empty only where that model has no data for the site or time. Columns without forecastModel are the blended forecast; the models it blends are listed in the dataset metadata, processing.modules entry solargis/forecastBlending. Other columns (e.g. KT, PAR, meteo, PV) are not split per model. Applies only to the forecast part of a timeseries.

forecastBlendingScheme.description: Forecast blending scheme (NWP models and satellite nowcast) used instead of the default one for the site's region, by name. The scheme blends irradiance (GHI, DNI); PV columns are simulated from the blended irradiance. Applies to the forecast part of a timeseries, live or historical; a date range with no forecast part is unaffected. A scheme none of whose models is available at the site is rejected. Models of the scheme without data for the site or period are left out and the blend uses the remaining ones. The models actually used are listed in the dataset metadata, processing.modules entry solargis/forecastBlending (properties scheme and models).

oneOf.description: Name of a predefined forecast blending scheme, e.g. DEFAULT.
Internal use only, not part of the public API.

forecastModels.description: Return the forecast models' own values instead of a blended forecast: each requested column that a forecast model provides (GHI, DNI, DIF, DHI and GTI with its components, with and without terrain shading, and LEADTIME) once per model, named <column>_<model> (historical forecast CONCATENATED: <column>_<model>_<leadPeriod>; SINGLE and the live forecast have no lead period), e.g. GHI_IFS, GHI_ICONEU_D1, with the model in the column metadata (forecastModel). No blended column is returned. ALL: every model available at the site for the requested period, within forecastSources, including the satellite nowcast (NOWCAST) where it reaches. A list names the models; a model that is not available is refused. Columns that depend on the forecast but have no per-model values, e.g. PVOUT, are refused; columns that do not depend on it (meteo, sun position) are returned once. The models delivered are listed in the processing module solargis/forecastModels.

forecastSources.description: Forecast sources to read, in the live forecast and in the historical forecast. NWP_FORECAST: numerical weather prediction models. NOWCAST: satellite-based nowcast. With both, they are blended as in operational forecasting. Default: [NWP_FORECAST, NOWCAST]; [NWP_FORECAST] switches the nowcast off, [NOWCAST] the NWP forecast. NOWCAST covers only the first hours after the forecast is processed, and its values are NaN beyond them when it is the only source. In a historical forecast it is used for D0, H*, M* and SINGLE and never reaches D1-D4: next to NWP_FORECAST the blend at D1-D4 is then the NWP forecast, and the per-model NOWCAST columns (includeForecastModelColumns, forecastModels) are returned for every lead period, empty where the nowcast does not reach, so the set of columns does not depend on the lead; NOWCAST alone is rejected when historicalForecast.leadPeriods contain D1-D4. forecastModels ALL takes the models of these sources only, and a listed model of an excluded source is refused. No effect on a date range without a forecast part.

allOf.$comment: forecastModels returns the models' own values, so it excludes a blending scheme and the per-model columns of the blend.

ForecastModelName.description: Forecast model, named as forecastModel in the dataset column metadata, e.g. IFS, ICONEU, GFS, NOWCAST for the satellite-based nowcast. The set of models evolves with Solargis forecasting and is not fixed by this schema; an unknown model is rejected.
